svg.title: Heavenly Sonata — Music of the Spheres. Draft 4 / Yin-Yang classification / forked tree (RUL-2026-10-03-005 recalibration).
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Opening Measure forks into Rising Crescendo then Fortissimo Finale, or Dissonant Chord then Prelude to Ruin. Harmonic Balance forks into Wall of Sound then Celestial Sanctum, or Muted Strings then Final Rest. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Yin-Yang jutsu.

both rows list all four stat types with no element, so at the pin they touch every non-pierce hit, and each is a +10% route. Three of the seven supported rows are Yin-Yang Genjutsu Damage on 60 AP casts (Foreboding Interlude 40, Frozen Melody 45, Lullaby 40 EP at jutsu level 25), so offense is a full secondary +5 Damage route. Foreboding Interlude's 35% exposure (Genjutsu-filtered, element-less) and Lullaby's 35% self buff (all four stat types, element-less) are the tertiary amplifiers: exposure is a +10% route, empowerment is Foundation-plus-capstone glue capped at +5% because that buff reaches every non-pierce hit the caster lands. No Afterburn, Lifesteal, Reflect, Heal or Increase Heal row exists, so none is invented. Increase Damage Given is glue (+2%, +3%; +5% maximum) because Lullaby's buff reaches every non-pierce hit the caster lands. The Damage route is the highest row-weighted build (23 on 7 rows).","Recalibration from Draft 3: Dissonant Chord +2% \u2192 +3% and Prelude to Ruin's exposure +3% \u2192 +5% move the Exposure route from +7% to the +10% band (Interlude 35 \u2192 45%). All other values are unchanged; maxima over every legal allocation: Damage +5, Increase Damage Given +5%, Increase Damage Taken +10%, Decrease Damage Taken +10%, Decrease Damage Given +10%.","Capstone secondaries: the tank capstones each take +2% of the other's tag (Celestial Sanctum +2% Decrease Damage Given, Final Rest +2% Decrease Damage Taken), below the sibling Hidden Arts' +3%, so the fortress/suppression hybrid (01, 06, 07, 09) is never dominated and neither tank capstone is an offensive buy. Prelude to Ruin takes +3% Increase Damage Given; Fortissimo Finale is Damage-only.","Downstream reach: the bloodline passive (Increase Damage Given 25% + 0.15/level on Fire, Lightning, Yin-Yang, None) is not a potency target; as a bloodline source it multiplies the enhanced Yin-Yang damage, while kit rows add. Lullaby's buff and Harmonic Chamber's suppression list all four stat types, no element: every non-pierce hit the caster lands or the target deals. Interlude's exposure lists only Genjutsu: Genjutsu hits of any element and element-less hits, not elemental Nin/Tai/Buki.","Delivery and timing: all five jutsu are cooldown 7; Interlude, Melody and Lullaby cost 60 AP, Shield and Chamber 40 AP. The Shield's SELF row is realized on the caster at cast (4b), not via the circle tiles.","Fourth purchases: Burst takes Harmonic Balance (37% / 37% defensive glue) or Dissonant Chord (40% exposure); Exposure takes Harmonic Balance or Rising Crescendo (+2 Damage); Fortress takes Muted Strings (42% suppression, pure tank) or Opening Measure (37% buff and exposure); Suppression takes Opening Measure or Wall of Sound (42% reduction, Shield only). All 14 full-budget allocations are numerically non-dominated and every node appears in one.","Reference reuse: topology and six nodes copy Taiyo Kami's values (Foundations +2% IDG/+2% IDT, +2% DDT/+2% DDG; Damage +2/+3; Hidden +3% DDT, +3% DDG). Off-kit Yin-Yang coverage is unverified.","Shield timing: the Decrease Damage Taken row has target SELF, so it is realized on the caster at cast, not via the circle tiles (actions.ts 980-1004, 1060+; SOURCE_MECHANICS 4b): no standing-still cost, no enemy hazard. Like every modifier it skips its cast round (adjustDamageTaken, tags.ts 1010) and covers the two rounds after, so it must be cast a round ahead of the hits it should absorb.","Tank-row breadth: Chamber's suppression and the Shield's reduction list four stat types, no element: any non-pierce hit qualifies. 45% suppression (40 AP) lowers the target's damage against allies too for the two rounds after the cast, beside drain 210 and cleanseprevent. Same-tag effects add (process.ts 1109-1117): two casters' Chambers on one target remove 90% of the staged base. Not simulated.","Increase Damage Given stacking: the +5% glue lifts Lullaby's self buff to 40%, which adds to every other jutsu, main-tree or gear percentage (with 45% exposure on the target, +85% of the staged base); the bloodline passive multiplies instead (fromType bloodline, allowBloodlineDamageIncrease). Four stat types, no element: every non-pierce hit the caster lands in the two rounds after the cast.","Exposure reach: Foreboding Interlude's row lists only Genjutsu with no element, so it amplifies Genjutsu hits of any element (the kit's Yin-Yang attacks) and every element-less hit from any source (basic attacks, weapons, non-elemental jutsu), allies' included, not elemental non-Genjutsu hits. Damage modifiers skip pierce. The Exposure build's row weight (19) understates its reach on a Genjutsu caster.","Realized value: three 60 AP attacks on cooldown 7 mean each 2-round window reaches at most the other two attacks per rotation, never its own jutsu's hit (SOURCE_MECHANICS 3b), so per-row numbers overstate per-round value. It is the kit's only multi-target reach, so +5 Damage on its 45 EP is the largest raw gain in the tree. g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Yin-Yang jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Prelude to Ruin path + Harmonic Balance
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDG: Decrease Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE HEAVENLY SONATA KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Draft 4 / Yin-Yang classification / forked tree (RUL-2026-10-03-005 recalibration)
